entries.272c6c28710c173d: A holding company of a retail group that operates drugstores and dispensing pharmacies mainly in Kanagawa Prefecture, and also handles supermarkets and nursing care.
entries.2ceabe6978b317f0: Paid Nursing Homes and Day Services Business
entries.5f7378ade9b30bdd: A business operating supermarkets that sell food and general merchandise. Yurigaoka Sangyo Co., Ltd. and Yaohan Fūdo Sentā Co., Ltd. are in charge. On October 29, 2025, the company acquired Yaohan Fūdo Sentā, which operates 8 food supermarkets in Kanuma and Nikko cities in Tochigi Prefecture, together with its parent company Yaohan Hōrudingusu Co., Ltd., and the business scale expanded. As of May 31, 2026, there were 9 food supermarkets. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥5,909 million, about 2.3 times the prior-year level.
entries.714b98ceeb69b7a9: A business providing nursing care services for the elderly, also called the “nursing care business.” Weruraifu Co., Ltd. is in charge of the paid nursing homes, and Saron Dei Co., Ltd. is in charge of the day services. As of May 31, 2026, the company operates 2 fee-based nursing homes with distinctive meals and 37 half-day day service centers specializing in rehabilitation. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥750 million for paid nursing homes and ¥1,600 million for day services.
entries.7581830f8d88d113: Customers of drugstores and dispensing pharmacies
entries.aee1de58db5b2302: The core business of the company, selling pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, food, daily sundries and similar products and providing dispensing services. Kurieito Esu Dī Co., Ltd. is responsible, while manufacturing and planning of private brand products is handled by Esuta Co., Ltd., and store cleaning and similar work by Kurieito Bigin Co., Ltd. As of May 31, 2026, the number of stores was 811 drugstores, 5 fresh food specialty stores combined with drugstores, 48 dispensing-only pharmacies and 442 dispensing pharmacies attached to drugstores. In the fiscal year ended May 2026, the company continued EDLP (everyday low pricing) in merchandise sales, and revenue grew as the number of dispensing pharmacies also increased. The company opened 33 new drugstores and closed 9. The company made Sanefu Co., Ltd., which operates 9 dispensing-only pharmacies, a subsidiary on August 29, 2025, and merged it into Kurieito Esu Dī on March 1, 2026. By merchandise category, food is the largest, followed by pharmaceuticals, general merchandise and cosmetics.
